body:
Split out of T-32 (which now covers the reliability fix: price validation +
row quarantine). This is T-32's other half — "sync failures are invisible."
No screen shows last-synced time, pending-change count, sync errors, or
(after T-32) rows quarantined by a server 422. The app silently stops
reflecting other devices / silently stops pushing a bad row.

Fix: a small @Singleton sync-status holder (StateFlow of last-sync time,
in-progress, last error, pending count, blocked-row count) updated by
SyncEngine on every run; a quiet status line on Overview (and/or the drawer),
loud when a failure repeats or a row is blocked ("1 item needs attention" ->
tap to open it). T-32 leaves a syncBlocked flag + quarantine in place that
this should surface. Web has the same gap (its useSync store already knows
loading/error — just needs a small indicator). Coordinate with T-36
(pull-to-refresh) — same surface.
relates: T-32, T-36
title: Android + web: surface sync health (last-synced / pending / failing / blocked rows)
